Name: Candace
Dialog: And it opens tomorrow. I bet Sweetwater will go see it and say she read the book. And if you do something like triangulate her movements against the movie schedule, you could bust her no prob.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, really, Stacy? Well, they're not gonna bust themselves! Oh, great, a sale. Now guess who's gonna have to go in there and try stuff on? Call ya later, Stace. Since I have to do everything!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? On Street Fair day? Haha! No way, sister! I'll be there, and I'll be there early. Ah-haha. Yeah. Alone. Okay? Okay. Oh crud. Make that molecular whatever and meet me at the coffee shop!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'm no help to you there. Talk to you later, Stace. Good luck. I wish I knew a girl like this so that I could hang out and absorb her coolness. Vanessa! Hey, Vanessa! Vanessa! Hey! Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What a bunch of babies. Wait a minute! Weird situation plus danger equals Phineas and Ferb! Okay, calm down. I'm on it! Mom? Mom, I want you to check and see if the boys are creating zombies!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can, uh, can I say something? So I think I'm up to date on the whole Perry-agent thing. Strangely, that's the most normal thing that's happened this afternoon... But who exactly is this guy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! The boys are up to something huge! I just know it! But they've hidden it within a massive pile of leaves in the backyard. Come help me sort through them for a few hours to find it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Commence Operation Concisely State What The Heck Is Going On Around Here. Notepad: check! Ducky Momo 15th Anniversary Happy Pencil: check! Keen eye and indomitable will to bust: check!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Sing, goddess, the anger of Peleus' son, Achilles..." "Achilles! And it's devastation, which put pains upon the Achaeans..." "Upon the Achaeans, hurled in their multitude to the House of--"

Dialog: Wait a minute wait a minute, what you're trying to say is that if Stacy is really my best friend, I should just apologize to her. And if I'm really Stacy's best friend, she'll take me back!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, Stacy, I tell my mom I'm heading to the mall to get some makeup and she hands me a list of other stuff I have to get. Why do I have to do everything? Shop at the mall, bust my brothers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, just put it there at the end. Okay, you can go now. Wow, I've been given all this power and how I've chosen to use it is to run through gold coins barefoot....I'm a genius!! Ha ha ha!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sold! Well, what do you know? It works! Wait, stop! Uh oh. Hey, this cow whistle doesn't work! Oh, they're so going to get it. Mom, they're driving a herd of cattle right through Downtown.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're not gonna believe this, Stacy, but when I turned around, Jeremy was standing right behind me. Well, actually he was sitting, and he was a couple blocks away, but he was right there!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way, Phineas. There's no way I'm lettin' this baby out of my sight. This is the single greatest moment in my life, and there is nothing you little creeps can do to take it away from me.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Or we could've all been captured, and I wasn't gonna take that chance. These are the tough choices, people. Somebody's gotta be the adult here. You two are safe, and that's what important.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it? That's all you're doing today? Huh. How normal. I guess my night's safe after all. Who would have guessed you two would get sucked into a video game? I'm going to go get ready.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No big deal? I'm Jeremy's girlfriend! We have to make a good impression! Breakfast is easy! This is brunch! Brunch! That's so fancy! Mom, what does this frittata say about us as a family?

Name: Candace
Dialog: People, people, I'm not gonna soft pedal this. That was adequate, but I think we're ready to witness the greatest architectural feat this town has ever seen! I give you Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aaah! Yes! Vanessa's dad's machine! It worked! Which means yesterday is today! Another chance to bust the boooo- -ooys! I didn't think there would be this part!– ugh! Har... dee har har.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not speaking metaphorically! The boys' inventions disappeared every single day last summer! And, of course, Mom never sees it! It's always, "Who wants pie? Oh, there you are, Perry."

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Apparently Giraffe Girl has robbed me." "Ferb has been working out." "Excuse me; my child can't see the movie over your monstrous giraffe head!" Oh, I'll show them. I'll show them all.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I guess it could've been worse. Okay, that does it. This thing is totally bad luck. Well; little amulet, this girl doesn't need any more misfortune. So bye-bye, bad luck! Over it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, things look pretty bleak. We may not be back after all. Phineas is in a cute trance. Mitch turned himself really adorable and defeated the entire Meap Army. There's no one left to-

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're so close, Candace! Don't cave now! The Mysterious Force is watching! So as long as you stay cool and casual. Come. Hee hee. Casually this way. MOM! Here we go. Just walk with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get my brothers to bust themselves? Get my brothers to bust themselves. Get my brothers to bust themselves!! Get my brothers to bust themselves!!! Get my brothers to bust themselves!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm going to the mall! I'll call Stacy. No, wait. Stacy's mad at me. And I'm mad at Stacy! But I can't go by myself. I'll look like a total dork. Okay, I'll just get a new best friend!

Name: Candace
Dialog: …So I said, "You're not getting me up into the mountains on a day like this", I'm staying right here, with my beautiful air conditioning. I'm just gonna chillax right through this one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, universe? If you were going to give me practically unbustable brothers, you could at least have made them not morning people. Yeah, I see ya down there. "Hey, where's Perry?"

Name: Candace
Dialog: Imagine, a whole day of hanging with Crash and the band! And, as an added bonus, a whole day of not thinking about my goofy brothers. Just me, you and The Bettys! Ahh, they're here!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not their party, it's my party! And it's not a party, it's an intimate get together. What was that? Put that down, pardon me, use a napkin! What is my science teacher doing here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, we've gotta split up. Ferb, hide Klimpaloon under your jacket to keep him quiet and I'll lure the guards the other way with my "Nang nang nang"! Just get him to the awards show!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, no matter, because we're driving this thing home. I'm calling Mom to make sure she's there to see this. You're going too slow! Give me that thing! So, how does this thing work?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was funny. Belching. It's so, uh... Male Right, bros? But yeah, maybe we should talk about something like, I don't know, does anyone have any deep thoughts they'd like to share?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're not getting me into one of those things! I'm not showin' up for my TV debut lookin' like a complete weirdo! What? I said, "Complete". And now, I must leave. My public awaits.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. What? No! You guys keep working, I'll narrate the audiobook. You stay here and help the boys. And not only will I finish recording your book today, I'll do it by four o'clock.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's one thing I don't understand about the lost superpowers. In all the comics I've read, energy can never be destroyed. Only morphed into a different form or contained somehow.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I know you want me to go left, but can't I technically make three rights to make a left? I mean, I know two wrongs don't make a right, but three rights do make a left, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dee Dee? Stacy? Who's Dee Dee? A Swedish exchange student?! I gotta go. Hey, wait for me! Let me through! Let me through! Oh, out of my way! My brothers are just driving me crazy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...But then, when I bring Mom into the backyard, it's gone and Mom never sees it. So here's my question, Mr. Supercomputer: How can I get my Mom to see what my brothers have done?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sisters, I know what you're thinking, but rest assured, this new Candace that you see before you will not react like the crazed little girl that crawled in here just this morning.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, uh, doin' some shoppin'? I mean, duh! Of course, you're shopping. You've got the items in the little basket thingy. You placed them in there with the intent to— Stop, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Building big, dangerous, bustable things with their imaginations! And also power tools. They even put up flyers. How'd they even get in here? Gotta go! I'll keep ya appraised.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you gonna do to them? No TV for a month? Or -- they have to serve me for a year. How about confiscating their toolbox? I know! Take away their seats on the city council!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you gonna do to them? No TV for a month? Or -- they have to serve me for a year. How about confiscating their toolbox? I know! Take away their seats on the city council!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, maybe he just wandered off. Doesn't he always wander off at some point in the day? A-And then later, when he comes back, you say, "Oh, there you are, Perry", and he says...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Then the boys' invention can't disappear before Mom sees it because she'll be in it! It's fool-proof! Phineas and Ferb will be busted once and for all! Can I borrow this? Thanks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't worry. I can do both! I've got a perfect view of them from where I'm sitting. Oh, yeah, that's what I'm talking about. I'm all up in their grill and they don't have a clue!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Omigosh! Cutie Patootie! My long-lost pet rabbit! Where have you been?! Oh, honey bunny, was Perry bothering you? Poor little fluffy britches patootie pants, let me get you home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, it's busy! I've just gotta win! Clearly I'm their biggest fan. See? Even my Betty boombox which rests on my Betty bedside table next to my Betty bed runs on Betty batteries!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't take it anymore!! Mom, I really tried my best to give you a day, but it's… the boys. The boys! They're in the parade! With giant floats! So come on, you gotta bust them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah! You know what? You're right. If I could do that, then I should be able to walk across the attic, right? It's being silly. Heck, I don't even remember what I was afraid of.

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? That's my point! Stuff's disappearing! and once it goes, nobody remembers it— e-ever existed... Moooooo- -om! It took them! Like the spoons! Mom, Phineas and Ferb are gone!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know what people take for granted? The sounds of the summer: the way ice crackles in a cold beverage, the bees buzzing on their busy way, the chirping of the summer birds...

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, what do you think I should wear to the fair tonight? I'm thinking my favorite red blouse with my white skirt and red matching socks. Stacy, I'm gonna have to call you back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right, hard to get. I'll call you back. Umm, about the car and the ride, I would love to! Wait, I mean, I better check my schedule. . You're in luck. I can just squeeze you in.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bwahahaha, letters to- Oh! Brilliant idea. Let's get together and write letters to Santa, and be very specific, within a reasonable price range. For fun. I'll be over in a bit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, well, let's see. What's different this year than last year? Oh, I know! You went out and got everyone in Danville involved in one of your off-the-cuff, harebrained schemes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And then I typed LOL, but it came out LOP, and Jeremy thought I meant... What's that smell? I'll call you later, Stacy. Cheese, huh? That warrants a call to Mom! What was that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hm. Well, you can't do nothing forever. And when you stop doing nothing, I'll start doing something, and that something will be busting you! Look at them plotting my downfall.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm, like, so looking forward to tonight. A special evening, just the two of us. So, what do you have planned? Horseback riding? I just love horseback riding. Oh, you stopped.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Wait! No! Ugh! No, I've been practicing diving, not skateboarding! Ugh. Everyone stop doing things that I'm not good at! Oh, this is a nightmare, come on Stacy, let's go--

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: Now where do I go? More importantly when? I know, I'll set it for a day I know I can bust the boys. Back to the first day of that summer. The day they built the rollercoaster.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah I know. Imagine if you had to choose between a blood-thirsty undead walking corpse and a slobbering hairy lupine man-beast for a boyfriend. What could possibly be cooler?

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is it, Candace – the last day of summer vacation! Your last chance to bust the boooo- -ooooooo – ugh! Uh! Why do we have this many wheeled objects lying around the house?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright. That should do it. I'll just walk all the way up to the top. Nothing will stand in my way. Why is it so dark out here? Ow! Oh, that hurts! Wait a minute. I got it! .

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Oh, no, no, no, no, no. Can't you guys just find some old nuts and bolts lying around and jerry-rig up some kind of machiney-deely-bob and get us out of this situation?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I'm so sorry. I'm gonna cancel with Jeremy today. Meet me at the cafe in half an hour and we'll hit the Street Fair afterwards. It'll be just the two of us. I promise.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Me too! You wouldn't believe the day I'm having so far! I mean really. Like I could go on. Like I could tell you all about it. I mean there's a lot that happened and there's—

Name: Candace
Dialog: That is so not true. Who ever heard of something as silly as turning someone to stone...? No, no, it can't be. I did it again. Don't look at me! I'm a monster! Make it stop!

Name: Candace
Dialog: As the fair princess in the tower, I declare Sir Charles the winner of the tournament... Wait a second. Could this be one of those things that backfires horribly on me? Nah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, a-as long as we agree that it's just a test. This isn't a "party" with a "band" playing, it's just a small get-together, and you're just gonna lightly strum a test song.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Jeremy's on his way over here right now. I've got like 5–10 minutes to get the whole "Busting-Phineas-and-Ferb" thing over so I can relax and we can enjoy our Saturday.

Name: Candace
Dialog: She's talking numbers, kid. Don't get a big head. Okay, mom, now watch what happens when he has to make a choice. Baljeet, would you like some grapes, or this chocolate bar?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, actually, it's Candace, but I guess you can call me "Carl". There's a zebra that calls me "Kevin". Mysterious Force, if this is really you, I need you to show me a sign!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aha! It's crawling with clues out here! Hmm... Look at these circular indentations in the dirt. And the subtle scent of rubber in the air. By Jove, Stacy! What could it be?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, if you need me, I'll be outside with Phineas and Ferb. And when you get a break from your French lesson, feel free to pop outside and check out what we're doing, okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Time to embark on my daily 500-brush-stroke marathon to manageable hair. One...What the—? A perfect 40º angle? I can't believe it! A perfect hair day! I finally got my PhD!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Clam it, wise guy! You know why I'm here and you better cooperate, because there are worse things than sittin' in a cold, dank prison cell with your little choo-choo train.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Vanessa! Just came by here to return your DVDs. Sorry I had them so long, can't say I understand French cinema. I mean, why does that mime keep letting go of balloons?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't help myself! MOOOOOOOOOM! PHINEAS AND FERB BUILT A RODEO IN THE BACKYARD WITH MECHANICAL BULLS AND BLEACHERS AND IS REALLY DANGEROUS! COME ON, YOU GOTTA BUST THEM!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm a teenage girl. Nobody has to teach me how to use a cell phone. Now if you'll excuse me, me and little phonsie-wonsie have to make up for lost time. Okay? Yeah, we do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Candace, you can do this! What's a couple little spiders compared to the fate of the world? Oh, who am I kidding?! I need support! Stacy, I really need your help!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Definitely! Definitely. Just, you know, taking it easy, and not being interested in anything the boys may or may not, mayhaps be participating in or thereabouts, casually.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why, yes. Yes I am. Okay, I'll get this thing started. And then because they're men, they'll want to take over and show me how to do it. Then I'll call Mom and bust them!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hehehehehehehehehehehehe... This is gonna be awesome, Stace! So when they get home, I'm gonna drag both of them into the backyard and it'll be a busting feeding frenzy!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. This is your pile of buildy stuff. This is what you liked to do before you became boring. Now take this. Well? Let's get this thing going! Do your stuff! You, here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? What are they up to today? Do they really think they can escape Mom's wrath by hiding in this fun, massive, glorious, autumnal leaf pile? Well, not if I can help it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got nothing. Every day, I wear myself out trying to bust the boys and it always blows up in my face. I'm gonna take a day off from exploding face. Today is for me time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I am so excited for some solid girl time with you guys tonight! I thought we could enjoy this charcuterie board, then play truth-or-dare, then watch a movie on my laptop!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmmm. The low stakes have definitely been raised. But, as always, it would be pointless to get Mom because, as always, the Mysterious Force would just take this all away.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Stace! It's Candace. Where are you? Call me! Hmm. That's weird. Who else can I call? I know! Jenny! I haven't seen her since the boys built a beach in the backyard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Jeremy, I had no idea you felt that way about me. But I still have a lot to accomplish before I get married. Hold on. Much more romantic. It's you! Hello, Jeremyyyy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, quick, Mom is in danger! And the award goes to... Oh, wait, shoot. On the corner of Fourth Street and Maple Drive! Beautiful! Now it's all up to The Dangiraffe.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, you're telling me that I could have had fun throughout this entire adventure if I had only stepped off the yellow sidewalk and joined my doofus brothers? Is that it?
